caption: The drawing features a single decorative object resembling an ornate pedestal or stand-alone structure, centrally positioned against a plain, beige background. The object consists of a square, flared base colored in shades of light brown, beige, and pale green, with each face of the base adorned with faint relief designs. Above the base, the structure narrows into a column featuring green and white marbled patterns and is topped with a square section decorated with golden-yellow floral motifs on each side. Above this is a bulbous, yellow-brown section supporting an elaborate top resembling a lidded urn or lamp, colored in gold and brown tones, and edged with a row of circular, bead-like decorations. Fine detailing using lines and subtle shading is present throughout, emphasizing the texture and solidity of the object. The artist's signature, "W. Kieckhofel," is visible to the lower right of the object.
title: Ceremonial Candlestick (Ecclesiastical Furniture)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
